Source: https://github.com/imangazalievm/android-developer-reference/blob/main/android_ndk.md

# Android NDK

- C++ language
  - Syntax
- C++ Standart library:
  - Data structures: vector, map, etc
  - Work with strings
  - Math operations
  - Date and time
- Android NDK
  - JNI
  - CMake
- Libraries
- Misc 
  - Files
  - Database
  - Images
  - Audio
  - Fonts
